key_insight: QAOA noise resilience depends on the choice of variational parameters, and this dependence can be bounded analytically under a Pauli noise model.
engineering_relevance: The result helps practitioners choose and optimize QAOA parameters to improve robustness on noisy near-term quantum hardware.
method: Derive an upper bound on total variation distance between noisy and noiseless QAOA outputs.
Use a Pauli noise model to connect the bound to variational parameters.
Propose error-penalty and truncated-search optimization strategies to exploit the bound.
evidence_signal: Noisy simulations support the analytic bound and indicate how parameter-generation strategies affect performance under noise.
watch_item: The noise model and bound may not fully capture device-specific or correlated hardware noise, so real-device performance could differ.
paper_title: Parameter-Dependent Noise Resilience in the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm
